def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for yy in range(3*h):
        ry = yy % (2*h)
        y = ry if ry < h else 2*h-1-ry
        row = []
        for xx in range(2*w):
            rx = xx % (2*w)
            x = rx if rx < w else 2*w-1-rx
            row.append(grid[y][x])
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
